commands.review_summary:
The PR adds exact and prefix modes to skill search across the v1 HTTP handler, Convex search action, CLI flags, and focused tests.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection on current main shows ranked search plus q/limit/filter inputs, but no exact or prefix mode in the search action, v1 HTTP handler, or CLI command.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Manual review is needed for the public API direction and contributor-supplied runtime proof; ClawSweeper should not queue a repair while proof is missing.

target.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes
target.body:
## Summary
- Add explicit `mode=prefix` and `mode=exact` support to the v1 skill search API.
- Route prefix search through the indexed skill-search digest slug path instead of semantic/vector recall.
- Expose `clawhub search --prefix` and `clawhub search --exact` with conflict validation.

Closes #1383.

## Validation
- `node_modules/.bin/vitest run convex/search.test.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/vitest run convex/httpApiV1.handlers.test.ts`
- `../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run -c vitest.config.ts src/cli/commands/skills.test.ts` from `packages/clawhub`
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/schema/tsconfig.json --noEmit`
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/clawhub/tsconfig.json --noEmit`
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/clawhub-admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig ./tsconfig.oxlint.json ./convex ./packages/clawhub/src`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check convex/search.ts convex/search.test.ts convex/httpApiV1/skillsV1.ts convex/httpApiV1.handlers.test.ts packages/clawhub/src/cli.ts packages/clawhub/src/cli/commands/skills.ts packages/clawhub/src/cli/commands/skills.test.ts`
- `VITE_CONVEX_URL=https://example.invalid SITE_URL= VITE_SITE_URL= node_modules/.bin/vitest run --exclude 'scripts/security-dataset/**'` (4268 passed, 1 skipped)
- `VITE_CONVEX_URL=https://example.invalid VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL=https://example.invalid node_modules/.bin/vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/clawhub.e2e.test.ts --testNamePattern "search endpoint returns a results array"` (run outside sandbox for live DNS)

## Local environment notes
- Full root `vitest run` with env vars set reached 4292 passed / 1 skipped and failed only 7 tests that spawn `bun`; this shell does not have a `bun` binary.
- `verify-convex-contract` also requires `bunx convex function-spec`, so it was not runnable in this shell.
